text:
max.sales: Heads up 10 — Kimura Corp wants private deployment pricing. They asked if we can remove the platform fee year 1 for a 12-month commit. Need SE + deal desk + security input.

leah.se: Are they asking VPC or on-prem? Also will they require customer-managed KMS?

max.sales: Starting with VPC + customer KMS for the pilot (45d). If pilot passes, full rollout for 12 months.

omar.eng: VPC + KMS onboarding = ~3 eng-days. On-prem would be a separate engagement (packaging + air-gap) and ~10 eng-days.

priya.dealdesk: Pricing options: waive platform fee for pilot only, or amortize onetime packaging over monthly fee, or offer reduced platform fee for committed term. Finance needs numbers to route approvals.

priya.dealdesk: Ballpark (internal):
- Platform list: $20k/mo
- Enterprise support: $5k/mo
- On-prem packaging: $30k one-time
- 12mo commit discount: 20% -> $16k/mo
- Pilot promo: waive first 45 days if they sign and pay within Net30

nina.security: We'll need the security questionnaire and SOC2 artifacts. KMS pattern documented; timeline for intake 3 business days for initial responses. If they request penetration testing or extra attestations for on-prem, add 2 weeks.

finance-bot: Reminder: any waived invoices must be reflected in contract schedule for ARR modeling. Approvals may require CRO if committed ARR > $1M.

max.sales: Proposed approach: 45d POC waived platform fee, then 12mo at 20% discount. Move any on-prem fees to SOW and offer amortization on billing. Anyone object?

omar.eng: Sounds fine. Add a clause in SOW about burst capacity and eng lead time for on-prem switch.

priya.dealdesk: I'll prepare approval packet. Estimated post-discount ARR = ~$384k. If this changes I need to know before routing.

customer.kimura: That timeline works. Procurement asks for single subscription line if possible. Happy to sign if we can start onboarding within 2 weeks.

priya.dealdesk: Noted. I'll kick off internal approvals and loop in legal for SOW language. Expect decision in 48-72 hours once ARR confirmed.

max.sales: Thanks all 10 I'll upload SOW draft and security intake link here shortly.
